label: prose:accuracy-dashboard
title: Accuracy dashboard
html:
The model takes three measured inputs: the electron mass, the proton-to-electron mass ratio (which fixes q_0), and the charged-pion mass. Every other entry below is computed from those three and compared with experiment. The full scorecard, with every observable, its uncertainty and its source, is ACCURACY.md in the repository; this table is generated from the same computations and changes when they do.

Quantity Model Experiment Difference Status
Muon mass (MeV) 105.6583978 105.6583755 +211 ppb (9.7\sigma) Derived
Tau-to-electron mass ratio 3477.44 3477.23 +61 ppm (0.9\sigma) Conditional
Kaon-to-pion mass ratio 3.5371186 3.5371184 +51 ppb Derived
Inverse fine-structure constant 137.035999127 137.035999177 -0.37 ppb (2.4\sigma) Conditional
Electroweak scale (GeV) 246.21964 246.21965 -29 ppb (0.1\sigma) Conditional
Neutron mass (MeV) 939.1085 939.5654 -486 ppm Conditional
Neutron–proton mass difference (MeV) 0.8364 1.2933 -35.3\% Conditional
Neutron \beta-decay Q-value (MeV) 0.3254 0.7823 -58.4\% Conditional
\beta^- decays of nuclei, exothermic 0 of 1009 1009 of 1009 median 142\% in Q Open
Deuteron binding (MeV) 2.265 2.225 +1.8\% Few-body model
Helium-4 binding (MeV) 29.33 28.30 +3.7\% Few-body model
Iron-56 binding (MeV) 135.1 492.3 -72.6\% Open
Binding, all 2542 nuclides with A \ge 2 chain proxy AME2020 median 69\% low Open

Derived means computed from the three inputs with no unproved hypothesis; conditional means the value rests on a stated conjecture or an unproved step; open means the model does not yet reproduce the quantity. Two of the close agreements carry further qualifications: the fine-structure value is conditional on an open step in the Lean formalisation, and the kaon-to-pion ratio includes a truncated correction series. The deuteron and helium-4 binding energies come from one of several few-body models compared in the full scorecard. Beyond the lightest nuclei the binding energies come from a chain proxy whose saturation is open, and they fall short by a median of 69\%. The \beta-decay values and the binding energies are the clearest places where the model, as it stands, does not yet work.
